konkani_inflectional_loc.root_cause_cited: Phase 1 & 2 LOC Diagnostic: Inflected location forms like पणजींत and गोयाच्या suffered 50% F1 penalty and 33.3% recall.

sinhala_loc_precision_filtering.root_cause_cited: Phase 3 Silver Re-Audit: LOC precision on independent gold train is only 57.81% due to toponymic heuristic over-generation on common spatial terms.
